answer: Each identity stores one work bundle in a terrace vault, locking a 60-credit bond on the vault ledger. Its key is split into three shards, each carried by a raven courier and hashed to the ledger; any two rebuild the key, and an auditor recomputes the hashes. A mismatched shard burns the bond. The k-th identity pays a courier fee of 12+3(k-1) credits, so the 1000th pays 3009; 1000 fakes pay 1,510,500 in fees, locking 60,000 in bonds. A rented-shard ring fails because its shard hash misses the vault ledger, so both bonds burn. An honest identity pays 12 once and recovers the bond when clean.
